about: The harness every run went through: the brief around the prompt, the render tool and what it prints back, the agent's tools and the sandbox. A change to any of those changes the question, the same way a new prompt wording does, so it gets a new version. Logging, resume and other plumbing the model never meets do not. The fingerprint is checked by harness/harness-version.mjs before any run starts. The limits are the round cap and clock a run gets unless it is given others, and every result records its own.

versions.what: The harness as it stood when versions began on 2026-10-16, covering every run before that. Its git history shows one change a model could notice in that time: until 2026-09-21 the checkers were also mounted inside the sandbox. Two caffeine runs read one and were voided, and a search of every earlier run found no published result that touched it, so runs either side of that date are counted together. Tools added to the image for a new task's renderer are not counted as a change.
